gloss: intense pain; sharp pain; severe pain

definitions.gloss: intense pain; sharp pain; severe pain
definitions.explanation: Extremely strong physical pain. Describes pain that is sudden, sharp, or overwhelmingly intense.

examples.japanese: {激痛|げきつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A sharp pain shot through me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{激痛|げきつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じて→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{動|うご}けなく→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I felt intense pain in my lower back and couldn't move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{激痛|げきつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられ→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ず、⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}{病院|びょういん}→救急病院：28802_kyuukyuubyouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Unable to bear the severe toothache, I went to the emergency hospital in the middle of the night.

notes:
USAGE:
A strong, dramatic word used to describe the most severe level of pain. Common in medical contexts and personal accounts of injury or illness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激痛|げきつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (a sharp pain shoots through)
- {激痛|げきつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧ (to be struck by intense pain)
- {激痛|げきつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel intense pain)
- {激痛|げきつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to endure intense pain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鈍痛|どんつう}→鈍痛：17382_dontsuu⟧: dull pain — a constant, throbbing pain, less sharp
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: pain — general, neutral term for pain
